title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
hints: A depth-first walk visits nodes in the wrong order for this output. Which traversal naturally visits a tree one level at a time?
Use a queue (collections.deque). The only real question is how to know where one level ends and the next begins.
At the start of each round record the queue's length: exactly that many pops belong to the current level. Collect their values, push their children, and the queue then holds precisely the next level.
